title: Butterfly eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='wingGrad' cx='30%' cy='30%' r='80%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3e6'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ff66cc'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc33aa'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='wingGrad2' cx='30%' cy='30%' r='80%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe680'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffcc33'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc9900'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Snack: a cookie/cupcake on a little leaf plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='16' ry='6' fill='#33cc66'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='16' ry='5' fill='#66ff99'/>

  <!-- Cupcake base -->
  <path d='M40 72 L44 58 L56 58 L60 72 Z' fill='#e6a04d'/>
  <path d='M40 72 L44 58 L48 58 L46 72 Z' fill='#c87f2e'/>
  <path d='M52 58 L56 58 L60 72 L56 72 Z' fill='#c87f2e'/>

  <!-- Frosting swirl -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='11' ry='7' fill='#ff99dd'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='52' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#ffc0ec'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='50' r='2' fill='#ff3388'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='51' r='1.6' fill='#ff3388'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='1.6' fill='#ff3388'/>

  <!-- Bite taken out of frosting (right side) -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='53' r='4' fill='#111133'/>

  <!-- Butterfly body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='3' ry='10' fill='#6633cc'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='2' ry='9' fill='#8866ee'/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='5' fill='#6633cc'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='4' fill='#8866ee'/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='30' r='1.6' fill='#11ffff'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='30' r='1.6' fill='#11ffff'/>

  <!-- Antennae -->
  <path d='M48 27 Q43 18 40 15' stroke='#8866ee' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M52 27 Q57 18 60 15' stroke='#8866ee' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='15' r='1.8' fill='#ff66cc'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='15' r='1.8' fill='#ff66cc'/>

  <!-- Upper left wing -->
  <path d='M48 36 Q30 20 18 30 Q14 40 26 44 Q38 46 48 40 Z' fill='url(#wingGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='33' r='4' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='38' r='3' fill='#ffe680'/>

  <!-- Upper right wing -->
  <path d='M52 36 Q70 20 82 30 Q86 40 74 44 Q62 46 52 40 Z' fill='url(#wingGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='33' r='4' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='38' r='3' fill='#ffe680'/>

  <!-- Lower left wing -->
  <path d='M48 44 Q32 48 24 60 Q26 70 38 66 Q46 58 49 48 Z' fill='url(#wingGrad2)'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='58' r='3' fill='#ff66cc'/>

  <!-- Lower right wing -->
  <path d='M52 44 Q68 48 76 60 Q74 70 62 66 Q54 58 51 48 Z' fill='url(#wingGrad2)'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='58' r='3' fill='#ff66cc'/>

  <!-- Proboscis reaching down to snack -->
  <path d='M50 36 Q50 42 50 50' stroke='#11ffff' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none'/>

  <!-- Crumbs near mouth / bite -->
  <circle cx='59' cy='58' r='1.2' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='55' r='1' fill='#ff99dd'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='60' r='1' fill='#ffe680'/>
</svg>
